title: Quartic Digamma Bridges, Harmonic Tail Moments, and Complex Resolvent Powers
novelty_scope: New relative to the inspected ProveIt corpus; no exhaustive global priority claim.
proof_scope: Written analytic proofs, independently reviewed; no formal proof-assistant certificate.

claims.title: Quartic digamma finite part and strict depth-three harmonic coefficient
claims.domain: Coordinate finite part on (0,1), with the endpoint coordinate x fixed.
claims.source_question: Cubic Harmonic Q6, explicitly requested k=4 case
dependencies: Inherited cubic bridge for the depth-two cancellation only
claims.limitation: No all-k reduction, ordinary-constant evaluation of theta, or arithmetic independence claim.

claims.title: Normally convergent normalized primitive and all argument derivatives
claims.domain: Primitive on Re(z)>0; derivative hierarchy away from nonpositive integer poles.
claims.normalization: Primitive has constant coefficient zero at its singular origin.

claims.title: Every centered nonpositive even moment of two even harmonic tails
claims.domain: Even p,q>=2 and every integer r>=0.
claims.source_question: Harmonic Parity R1, pure two-tail family
dependencies: Centered Hurwitz asymptotics and trivial zeros
claims.limitation: Does not include extra H_n factors, odd harmonic factors, four tails, or spectral derivatives.

claims.title: Fixed ordinary-zeta spanning set independent of moment order
claims.limitation: At most max(p,q) specified coordinates; no arithmetic independence claim.

claims.title: All (2,4) moments generated rationally by the first four
claims.domain: All centered even moments for p=2,q=4.
claims.consequence: An explicitly subtracted ordinary convergent polygamma series equals -88.

claims.title: Analytic all-pair generator and finite classical-polylogarithm expression
claims.domain: Holomorphic EGF for |t|<2*pi; displayed Li_k(e^-t) formula first for real 0<t<2*pi.
claims.normalization: Integral form fixes holomorphic continuation at t=0.
claims.limitation: The full EGF retains the elementary factor t/(2*sinh(t/2)).

claims.title: Beta mixture of ordinary polylogarithms and complex-power Hurwitz transform
claims.domain: Euler mixture: -1<Re(lambda)<1, |q|<1, Re(nu+lambda)>0. Ordinary Hurwitz integral: Re(lambda)>-1, Re(u+lambda)>p, excluding the Hurwitz pole when p=0.
claims.normalization: Continuous Log R from log x at zero; nonreal z selects a half-plane.
claims.limitation: Spectral meromorphic continuation is distinct from exceptional pointwise specialization.

claims.title: Full joint Stieltjes completion at every integer power
claims.domain: p,m,k>=0, every integer L, nonreal z; separate noninteger-lambda formula.
claims.normalization: Fixed endpoint coordinates x and 1-x; both full moving amplitudes retained.
claims.limitation: Negative-power removable quotient has a nonzero finite value and must not be omitted.

claims.title: All Stieltjes indices with one resolvent logarithm
dependencies: First lambda derivative of the explicit Fourier coefficients

claims.title: All logarithmic parameter derivatives and normalized primitives
claims.domain: Within either fixed open half-plane, arbitrary nonnegative m,p,k and integral L.
claims.normalization: Difference at a specified base point z0 in the same half-plane.

claims.title: Every ordinary exponential and Bernoulli moment
claims.domain: Nonreal z, Re(lambda)>-1; exponential parameter t arbitrary complex.
claims.normalization: Regularized Gauss series used at third-parameter resonances.

claims.title: Independent all-integer residue proof of the negative-power contact
claims.domain: Every positive integer M; either half-plane sign.
